import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long x, y, n;

    public static long gcd(long a, long b) {
        return (b == 0) ? a : gcd(b, a % b);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        x = sc.nextLong();
        y = sc.nextLong();
        n = sc.nextLong();

        if (y <= n) {
            long a = gcd(x, y);
            x /= a;
            y /= a;
            System.out.println(x + "/" + y);
            sc.close();
            return;
        }
        if (x == y) {
            System.out.println("1/1");
            sc.close();
            return;
        }

        double ans = 1e18;
        double xy = (double) x / (double) y;
        long ansx = 0, ansy = 1;
        long l = 0, r = y;

        for (long i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            while (i * x > r) {
                l += y;
                r += y;
            }
            if (i * x >= l && i * x <= r) {
                long ll = l / y;
                long rr = r / y;
                double li = (double) ll / (double) i;
                double ri = (double) rr / (double) i;
                double tmp1 = Math.abs(xy - li);
                double tmp2 = Math.abs(xy - ri);
                if (tmp2 < tmp1) {
                    if (tmp2 < ans) {
                        ans = tmp2;
                        ansx = rr;
                        ansy = i;
                    }
                } else {
                    if (tmp1 < ans) {
                        ans = tmp1;
                        ansx = ll;
                        ansy = i;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        long a = gcd(ansx, ansy);
        ansx /= a;
        ansy /= a;
        System.out.println(ansx + "/" + ansy);
        sc.close();
    }
}
